title: SeekersEventEnvelope
description: Standard event envelope for all asynchronous domain events published to the event bus.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific event occurrence (UUIDv4 or UUIDv7).

event_type.description: Domain-qualified event type identifier with explicit version suffix (e.g., job.collected.v1, job.ingested.v1).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the event schema.

producer.description: Identifier of the service emitting the event.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recording when the event was produced.

correlation_id.description: End-to-end request correlation identifier originating at API gateway or scheduler.

causation_id.description: Identifier of the preceding event or command that caused this event to occur.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value.

tracestate.description: W3C Trace Context tracestate header value.

payload.description: Event-specific domain payload conforming to the event_type schema.
